title: A Crucible pack instance: <data>/profiles/<pid>/pack/instance.json
description: Which pack a profile is an instance of. Beside it: base/ (the installed version's kiln-modpack.json and override files: the merge base of the next update) and undo/ (meta.json, config/, instance.json and base/ from before the last update). Written by kiln-manage modpack::pack.

optional.description: The player's switches of optional mods.

previous.description: The version before the last update (Undo goes back to it).
